# libwebp (BSD-3-Clause, see COPYING), decoder subset only: lossless/lossy/alpha decode of the theme's .webp images.
# Files copied from libwebp (build tree of the ROCKNIX image); SIMD variants are compiled for the matching CPU only.
file(GLOB WEBP_SRC CONFIGURE_DEPENDS src/dec/*.c src/utils/*.c)
set(WEBP_DSP
  alpha_processing cpu dec dec_clip_tables filters lossless rescaler upsampling yuv)
foreach(f ${WEBP_DSP})
  list(APPEND WEBP_SRC src/dsp/${f}.c)
endforeach()
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "aarch64|arm64")
  foreach(f alpha_processing dec filters lossless rescaler upsampling yuv)
    list(APPEND WEBP_SRC src/dsp/${f}_neon.c)
  endforeach()
elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "x86_64|AMD64")
  foreach(f alpha_processing dec filters lossless rescaler upsampling yuv)
    list(APPEND WEBP_SRC src/dsp/${f}_sse2.c)
  endforeach()
  foreach(f alpha_processing dec lossless upsampling yuv)
    list(APPEND WEBP_SRC src/dsp/${f}_sse41.c)
    set_source_files_properties(src/dsp/${f}_sse41.c PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-msse4.1")
  endforeach()
endif()
add_library(zf_webp STATIC ${WEBP_SRC})
target_include_directories(zf_webp PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_compile_options(zf_webp PRIVATE -O2 -w)
set_target_properties(zf_webp PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(zf_webp PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
